name: 4SHOBOSHOW
overview: 4SHOBOSHOW is the official premier variety web show of the South Korean boy band LNGSHOT. The group, which consists of members Ohyul, Ryul, Woojin, and Louis, was formed under Jay Park's record label More Vision. Premiering on March 24, 2026, the series serves as a dedicated platform for the members to showcase their chemistry, humor, and distinct personalities outside of their music
